observed_failure: Recovery parser again stopped at W-S/0 shader before adjudication.
root_cause: The v0.1.1 recovery parser used replace('\\\\','/'), which matches two consecutive backslash characters. After json.loads, a Windows path contains one backslash character per separator, so basename normalization did not occur.
correction: Use a shader_basename helper that replaces each single backslash with '/', then takes the final path component.
regression: Embedded assertion uses a full Windows compiled_shaders path and must resolve to p7_q4k_gemm_2d.spv.
